title: Add New
subtitle: Search every enabled metadata provider for a game to add to the Library.

empty.title: Type to search
empty.body: Start typing a game title — Romarr queries every enabled metadata provider (IGDB, ScreenScraper, MobyGames, …) and shows the merged candidate list ranked by confidence.

noResults: No candidates returned for "{{q}}". Try a different spelling or check that providers are configured under Settings > Metadata Sources.

filters.title: Filters
filters.noMatches: No candidates match the current filters.

addHint: Once added the metadata aggregator enriches the rest of the fields (summary, cover, release date, …) on the next refresh cycle. Field-level edits stay editable on the Game Detail page.

add.noPlatforms: No platforms configured. Add one under Settings > Platforms first.
add.noLibraries: No libraries configured. Add one under Settings > Libraries first.
add.refreshHint: Romarr will fetch the rest of the metadata in the background — the Game appears in the Library immediately.
